units.source_text: 却说夕颜死后，七七四十九日的法事，在比叡山的法华堂秘密举行。

en.t: After Yugao died, the forty-ninth-day memorial service was held secretly in the Lotus Hall on Mount Hiei.

units.source_text: 排场十分体面：

en.t: The arrangements were carried out with great dignity:

units.source_text: 从僧众装束开始，以至布施、供养等种种调度，无不周到。

en.t: from the monks' vestments to the offerings, alms, and every other provision, nothing was left unattended.

units.source_text: 经卷、佛堂的装饰都特别讲究，

en.t: The sutra scrolls and the decorations of the Buddha hall were prepared with special care,

units.source_text: 念佛、诵经都很虔诚。

en.t: and the chanting of the Buddha's name and the recitation of sutras were performed with deep devotion.

units.source_text: 惟光的哥哥阿阇梨是个道行深造的高僧，

en.t: Koremitsu's elder brother, the Ajari, was a highly learned monk of profound spiritual training,

units.source_text: 法事由他主持，庄严无比。

en.t: and with him presiding over the service, it was solemn beyond compare.

units.source_text: 源氏公子召请他所亲近的老师文章博士来书写法事的祈愿文。

en.t: Prince Genji summoned the professor of letters, a teacher close to him, to write the prayer text for the memorial service.

units.source_text: 他自己起草，草稿中并不写出死者姓名，

en.t: He drafted it himself, but in the draft he did not write the name of the deceased,

units.source_text: 但言“今有可爱之人，因病身亡，

en.t: saying only, "Now there was a beloved person who died of illness,

units.source_text: 伏愿阿弥陀佛，慈悲接引……”

en.t: and I humbly pray that Amida Buddha, in compassion, will receive and guide her..."

units.source_text: 写得缠绵悱恻，情深意真。

en.t: It was written with lingering sorrow and tenderness, full of deep and sincere feeling.

units.source_text: 博士看了说：“如此甚好，不须添削了。”

en.t: After reading it, the professor said, "This is very good as it is; there is no need to add or revise anything."

units.source_text: 源氏公子虽然竭力隐忍，

en.t: Although Prince Genji did his utmost to restrain himself,

units.source_text: 不禁悲从中来，泪盈于睫。

en.t: grief rose unbidden from within him, and tears filled his lashes.

units.source_text: 博士睹此光景，颇为关心：

en.t: Seeing this, the professor grew quite concerned:

units.source_text: “究竟是怎样的一个人？

en.t: "What sort of person was this, after all?

units.source_text: 并未听说有人亡故呢。

en.t: I have not heard that anyone has passed away.

units.source_text: 公子如此悲伤，此人宿缘一定甚深！”

en.t: For you to grieve so deeply, the bond from a former life with this person must have been very profound!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子秘密置备焚化给死者的服装，

en.t: Prince Genji had secretly prepared clothing to be burned as an offering for the deceased,

units.source_text: 此时叫人将裙子拿来，亲手在裙带上打一个结[\[39\]](#part1333.html#m39)，

en.t: and now he had someone bring the skirt, then personally tied a knot in its sash[\[39\]](#part1333.html#m39),

units.source_text: 吟道：

en.t: and recited:
